Sources: SEMrush · Meta Ad Library · Google Ads Transparency

[Presenter A] · 3:40–5:00. Compare the four systems left to right. Owned: Bank Muscat's outer orbit is the biggest, about 1.25M social followers, roughly 2.5 times SIB (508.6k), with Bank Dhofar (368k) and NBO (331.6k) behind. Paid: Bank Muscat runs the most active ads (92: 33 Meta, 59 Google), SIB is close behind (79) with the most Google ads (71), and Bank Dhofar and NBO have 27 each. Earned: Bank Muscat leads backlinks (221k) and AI visibility score (74), NBO has the most AI-cited pages (441), and SIB has the most positive sentiment (70%). NBO also runs the @cademy24/7 digital academy. Last slide for Presenter A: hand over to Presenter B. [Your words here.]

[Presenter B] · 8:10–9:30. Walk the road left to right. 1 Awareness (TOFU): Mohammed hears about the service at a late-night coffee business meeting; Salima sees an Instagram post on the new interest rate. Pain: no cognitive bandwidth to learn the digital channels. Fix: reduce the page choices and add a simple questionnaire at each awareness channel; as Sauer and Sonderegger (2022) found, visual aesthetics had no effect once usability was controlled, so usability comes first. KPI: backlink traffic, 221K on Semrush in September. 2 Consideration (MOFU): Google search (SEO / SEM). Fix: faster loading between pages by reducing the speed index. 3 Conversion (BOFU): corporate login and the online car loan form; fix the login time-out by reducing page generation time. 4 Retention: the most important stage in financial services; Mohammed logs in daily (8:44 per visit), Salima uses mobile banking; fix faster chatbot access to support. 5 Advocacy: recommendations spread the same way awareness arrived; measure app store ratings and NPS.
